newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AAPC launches Sofitel hotel in Japan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AAPC launches Sofitel hotel in Japan.

text.p: Hotel group AAPC Ltd said it has launched its first deluxe hotel in Japan, Hotel Sofitel Tokyo, which previously traded under the name Hotel Cosima.

AAPC, which is controlled by French hotel group, Accor SA, said the rebranding of the Hotel Cosima to Hotel Sofitel Tokyo is part of a business co-operation agreement signed between AAPC and the Hokke Club.

Under the agreement, AAPC will jointly manage the Hokke Club's other 12 hotels that the Japanese group leases and owns, AAPC said. These hotels are being considered for rebranding as Mecure hotels and inns, it said. -- Sydney 61-2 9373-1800
